plan.thresholds: Independent coarse 0..1 step1/8 plus nine points within +/-1/8 of each metric's coarse winner; shared evaluations but separate selection pools; ties prefer larger threshold
plan.noninferiority: Simplified minus full, paired original-document bootstrap; F1 margin0.005 only. F0.5 differences have descriptive intervals, no invented gate.
plan.heldout: Never read test/wikipedia_test text, labels or scores in this analysis. Reused validation intervals are descriptive after selection.
plan.strata: Original-document relative thirds, document byte length, repeated suffix length, candidate patch distance, teacher/candidate threshold margin; forced0/1 excluded and virtual next position included
plan.timing: After CPU analysis, isolated teacher/candidate patcher prefill and32 identical extensions; validation-only8inputs, warmup3/repeat10, alternate mode order, synchronization, temperature/power/clocks; not full-model inference
plan.limits: Existing RSS48GiB/GPU28GiB/minimum free disk100GiB/new artifacts100GiB, maximum24 configurations/33 thresholds each; no automatic limit increases

limitations: Reused train/validation, no heldout access. Post-selection validation bootstrap is descriptive. No F0.5 acceptance gate was supplied. No20GB or Neuron job is launched.
